Sunt au-tem gratulatoriae apud Ciceronem epistolae variae. Gratulationes de restitutione & revocatione ab exilio.lib.6.epist.11.12. obtenta in iudicio victoria, & absolutione. lib.3.epist.11.12. Imitationis exemplum.lib.13.epist.73. Nos ex his 7.lib.2. i-mitari conabimur, in qua de tribunatu Cicero Curioni gratulatur. Partes epistolae illius sunt quatuor. Exordium in quo feram gratulationem Cicero excusat, e-iusdemque causam, cum in loci interuallum, tum raritatem tabellariorum trans-fert. Propositio, quae συγχαιρεισίαν[?] gratulationem, cum [illegible, ~6 letters] adhortatione coniu-ctam,

page.notes: Marginal notes: "Materiæ gratulationum variæ in epistolis Cicer." (three lines, "gra-/tulationum/epi-/stolis"; placed at the line "lib.12.epist.13."). "Imitationis exemplum." (placed at the line "triam. lib.13.epist.73."). Doubtful: the Greek word after "quae" (marked [?]) and the Greek word after "cum" (illegible, the scan is blurred and small). The last word "coniu-ctam," is partly unclear. The hyphen-broken words "v-sum" and "tranf-fert" were read as "u-sum" and "trans-fert" by the u/v and long-s rules.
